tui.description: Terminal UI (FTXUI). Optional: default installs omit it. The audited release is 7.0.3 (SHA-pinned in cmake/FetchFTXUI.cmake); the builtin-baseline only provides ftxui 6.1.9, so no 7.0.3 override is set here. CMake requires find_package(ftxui 7.0.3), so a baseline 6.1.9 install is rejected and the SHA-pinned FetchContent is authoritative. Bumping the baseline to expose 7.0.3 is a separate change.
